title: China-to-Bulgaria Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EMC — IEC 62920 and IEC 61000 Evidence for Bulgaria PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: Bulgaria PV inverter EMC expectations should be prepared on an IEC/EN basis because BDS (Bulgarian Institute for Standardization) adopts EN/IEC standards, and project specifications for grid-connected PV commonly reference IEC-family inverter evidence under the EU EMC Directive 2014/30/EU. The practical EMC package should include IEC 62920 for PV power conversion equipment and applicable IEC 61000-series evidence for emissions, immunity, harmonics, surge, voltage dips, and power quality. For ESO grid-connected projects, harmonic and conducted-emission evidence should be tied to the actual inverter model, rating, and configuration. Bulgaria uses a 230/400 V, 50 Hz grid — EMC and harmonic results obtained only under China 220/380 V conditions should be reviewed for applicability before submission to Bulgarian authorities.
target_standards: IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems — EMC requirements and test methods for power conversion equipment
IEC 61000 series — Electromagnetic compatibility test, immunity, harmonic, surge, voltage-dip, and power-quality standards as applicable to the inverter configuration
Directive 2014/30/EU (EMC Directive) — mandatory for CE marking in Bulgaria as EU member state
BDS standards adoption and project specification requirements where applicable
ESO grid-connection review requirements for power quality and harmonic performance
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter EMC evidence commonly relies on GB/T 37408-2021 and related domestic EMC test reports from CNAS-accredited laboratories. These reports can be useful engineering background but are not automatically equivalent to IEC 62920 or the IEC 61000-series evidence requested by a Bulgarian project owner, BDS conformity route, EWRC review, or ESO grid-connection process. China test conditions are normally aligned with the China 220/380 V, 50 Hz baseline, while Bulgaria uses 230/400 V at the same frequency.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CNAS-accredited domestic EMC test reports under China standard scopes
rows.gap: Gap: China-only EMC certificates under GB/T 37408 do not automatically satisfy Bulgaria IEC/EN-based project expectations or EU EMC Directive requirements. Exporters should obtain IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the specific model or family, confirm whether harmonics and conducted-emission results remain valid at 230/400 V, and provide surge, earthing, shielding, and enclosure documentation suitable for Bulgarian installation conditions. Where ESO or the project owner specifies harmonic limits or power-quality measurements, test reports should be mapped clause-by-clause to that requirement. Bulgarian-language documentation may be required by local project owners.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory under EU EMC Directive 2014/30/EU for CE marking in Bulgaria; project-specific and effectively mandatory where BDS, EWRC, ESO, or project-owner documentation calls for IEC EMC and power-quality evidence
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T 37408 EMC evidence is a China domestic voluntary or certification-programme baseline and is not a Bulgarian IEC/EN evidence substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat Bulgaria PV inverter EMC as an IEC/EN evidence package, not a China GB/T certificate transfer. Prepare IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the exact inverter model, review harmonic and EMC applicability at Bulgaria's 230/400 V 50 Hz grid voltage, and confirm any BDS, EWRC, ESO, or project-owner EMC requirements before shipment.

rows.requirement: ESO Grid-Connection Review — IEC 62116, IEC 61727, and 230/400 V 50 Hz Settings (Bulgaria)
rows.target_requirement: Grid-connected solar PV inverters in Bulgaria should be treated as project-level grid-connection equipment subject to Electricity System Operator (ESO) technical review and Energy and Water Regulatory Commission (EWRC) energy-sector oversight. The practical IEC evidence package normally includes IEC 62116 anti-islanding and IEC 61727 utility-interface compliance, with firmware protection thresholds, reconnection delay, voltage windows, and frequency windows validated for Bulgaria's 230/400 V, 50 Hz low-voltage grid. Bulgaria uses the same 50 Hz frequency as China, but the nominal voltage differs: Bulgaria is 230 V single-phase and 400 V three-phase (EU standard), while China is 220/380 V under GB/T 156. Large-scale PV projects in Bulgaria are also subject to EU RfG Commission Regulation (EU) 2016/631 above applicable thresholds.
target_standards: IEC 62116 — Utility-interconnected photovoltaic inverters — Test procedure of islanding prevention measures
IEC 61727 — Photovoltaic systems — Characteristics of the utility interface
EN 50549-1:2019 / EN 50549-2:2019 (CENELEC harmonised grid-connection standards for generators)
ESO project grid-connection and commissioning requirements for the relevant installation
EWRC electricity-sector approval or oversight requirements where applicable
Bulgaria low-voltage grid context — 230 V single-phase / 400 V three-phase, 50 Hz
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter grid-connection evidence commonly includes GB/T 19964-2024 for PV power station connection, NB/T 32004 for grid-connected inverter technical specifications, GB/T 37408 for PV grid-connected inverter requirements, and domestic anti-islanding test results. These documents are built around China grid conditions and domestic acceptance procedures. China's low-voltage baseline is 220/380 V at 50 Hz, not Bulgaria's 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Chinese grid certificates and factory firmware settings do not automatically transfer to ESO acceptance or EWRC project review in Bulgaria.
china_standards: GB/T 19964-2024 — 光伏发电站接入电力系统技术规定 (Technical Requirements for Connecting Photovoltaic Power Station to Power System)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
rows.gap: Gap: China GB/T and NB/T grid-connection evidence is not a substitute for Bulgaria ESO project acceptance. Exporters should prepare IEC 62116 anti-islanding evidence, IEC 61727 utility-interface evidence, a Bulgaria-specific settings file, and commissioning records for 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Do not describe Bulgaria voltage as matching China: only the 50 Hz frequency matches, while nominal voltage differs from China's 220/380 V. For large-scale projects, Commission Regulation (EU) 2016/631 compliance under ESO-defined thresholds is required. Bulgarian-language documentation should be prepared for all regulatory submissions.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice for grid-connected projects through ESO technical review and EWRC approval or oversight; EU RfG 2016/631 is binding for power-generating modules above ESO-defined thresholds
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese grid-connection evidence satisfies China domestic grid acceptance only and is not an ESO Bulgaria approval substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Chinese GB/T grid-connection documents do not automatically satisfy Bulgaria ESO grid-connection review. Prepare IEC 62116 and IEC 61727 evidence, re-parameterise inverter firmware for Bulgaria's 230/400 V at 50 Hz grid, and document earthing, surge protection, and commissioning records. Verify current ESO and EWRC project requirements directly before shipment or commissioning.

rows.requirement: IEC 62109-1 / IEC 62109-2 Safety Evidence for Bulgaria PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: For Bulgaria solar PV projects, inverter safety documentation should be prepared around IEC 62109-1 and IEC 62109-2 type-test evidence for the exact inverter model or family. BDS is the national standards body adopting EN/IEC norms; EWRC oversees the energy sector; and ESO controls the practical grid-connection interface. Project submissions should include accredited IEC safety reports, installation manuals, ratings, nameplate data, protection-device coordination, earthing instructions, and environmental limits. CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU is mandatory for all PV inverters placed on the Bulgarian market. Bulgarian-language instructions and labelling may be required under national market-surveillance and consumer-protection rules.
target_standards: IEC 62109-1 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 1: General requirements
IEC 62109-2 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 2: Particular requirements for inverters

rows.china_equivalent: China safety documentation for PV grid-connected inverters commonly uses GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, domestic CQC or CGC voluntary certification, and CNAS-accredited laboratory reports. These documents are useful for supplier qualification but are not automatically accepted as IEC 62109-1/-2 evidence for Bulgarian projects. Chinese safety reports may also be based on China-rated configurations, labels, manuals, surge protection, and 220/380 V assumptions, while Bulgarian project files must reflect 230/400 V, 50 Hz installation conditions.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CQC / CGC voluntary certification programmes for China domestic PV inverter safety and performance
rows.gap: Gap: A China-only GB/T 37408 or NB/T 32004 safety file does not automatically satisfy Bulgaria IEC safety expectations or LVD requirements. Exporters should provide IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test reports for the supplied model or model family, confirm that labels and manuals match the Bulgarian configuration at 230/400 V 50 Hz, document protection coordination and earthing, and ensure CE marking is obtained with an EU Declaration of Conformity. Bulgarian-language instructions may be required under national market-surveillance rules. An EU Authorised Representative must be appointed if no EU importer is established.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU is required for all PV inverters placed on the Bulgarian market; IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test evidence is mandatory in practice where BDS, EWRC, ESO, EPC, lender, or project-owner documentation requires it
mandatory_status.cn: China GB/T, NB/T, CQC, or CGC safety evidence applies to China domestic or voluntary certification contexts and is not automatically transferable to Bulgaria

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on China GB/T or NB/T inverter safety files alone for Bulgaria PV projects. Prepare IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test evidence for the exact model, obtain CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU, align labels and manuals to Bulgaria's 230/400 V 50 Hz configuration, and confirm current BDS, EWRC, ESO, and project-owner safety requirements before shipment.
